questionSnapshot.question: Where are the toys taken before they plan an escape from Lotso in Toy Story 3?

notes: Read all four options, full matching topic digests and cross-bank comparisons; checked wording, category, editorial difficulty and main-film scope. Original wording could validly suggest Bonnie’s final home. Final wording instead asks the Lotso-controlled location from which they escape, explicitly Sunnyside in D23.
